c2505b4e0f (merged origin/main; 0 behind).
1 TRAILER: PR retitled to end in (TASK-1948); body says Refs STORY-1853 (S0/S0b/S1), does not complete it. Existing commits not rewritten.
2 parse_log: a result attaches only to a row without one, or to the binary currently running. New test: slow_one 45s, then a reexec child result (1 passed); slow_one keeps 45s and fails the empty budget.
3 hook: scans the raw COMMAND for NO_SLOT followed by an optional + and then =. Tests cover bash -c, sh -c, +=, bare export (all blocked) and env -u (allowed). Indirect ${X}=1 is out of scope, per a comment. Behaviour change: the old 'mail heredoc mentioning the assignment is allowed' case now blocks under the raw scan; I flipped that test to expect a block.
4 test-touched: env_flag accepts only 1/true/yes (case-insensitive); the new test covers 0/false/no/empty.
5 AC4 per-test deferral to S2 is stated in the PR body.
Gate: check-ci-fast passed (31 gates); unittest for test_touched + test_story_1853 passed (56); hook test passed; check-templates OK. No .rs changed by me, so I skipped check-ci-compile.
